# cork-nav-sub-popover

A sub menu in a popover: a full-width button that opens a tray with the title and drill-down of a [`CorkNavSub`](../elements/cork-nav-sub.md).
Takes the same light DOM as cork-nav-sub. The drill-down always uses auto height.

The browser closes the tray when the user clicks outside it or presses Escape (after any open submenus are closed), and returns focus to the button.
In a SPA using @ucd-lib/cork-app-state, the tray also closes when the location changes, with an [`AppStateController`](../utils/controllers/AppStateController.md).
Set the no-app-state-close attribute to turn this off. In any other SPA, call hide() from your router on navigation.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `buttonLabel` | `String` | The button's text. Default: 'Submenu'. Attribute: button-label. |
| `headingLabel` | `Boolean` | Uses the title's text as the button's text, if there is a title. Attribute: heading-label. |
| `hideHeading` | `Boolean` | Leaves the title out of the tray. Attribute: hide-heading. |
| `noAppStateClose` | `Boolean` | Stops the tray from closing on cork-app-state location changes. Attribute: no-app-state-close. |
| `navAriaLabel` | `String` | Label for the nav. Default: the title's text, or 'Submenu' if there's no title. Attribute: nav-aria-label. |
| `focusedNavItem` | `Number[]` | navPosition of the focused item, e.g. [1, 0]. Attribute: focused-nav-item, comma-separated (e.g. "1,0"). |
| `isOpen` | `Boolean` | Whether the tray is open. Read only. |

## Slots

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | Title and menu, as in cork-nav-sub. Not an actual slot, but rather parsed and rendered into the shadow DOM by controllers. The title is an h1-h6, or a div/span with the data-heading attribute (optionally a level, e.g. data-heading="h2", for that level's look), optionally wrapping a link or button. See [`HeadingController`](../utils/controllers/HeadingController.md). The menu is a ul/ol of li elements, nested for sub menus. See [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md) for the markup formats. |

## Events

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cork-popover-toggle` | Fired when the tray opens or closes, with detail.open. See [`PopoverController`](../utils/controllers/PopoverController.md). |
| `cork-nav-item-click` | Fired when a rendered menu link or button is clicked, with the clicked item in detail.navItem. See [`NavController`](../utils/controllers/NavController.md). |
| `cork-heading-click` | Fired when a linked title is clicked, with the title in detail.heading. See [`HeadingController`](../utils/controllers/HeadingController.md). |

## Methods

### get isOpen

Whether the tray is open.

**Returns:** `Boolean`

### show()

Opens the tray.

### hide()

Closes the tray. Call it from an SPA's router on navigation, unless the app uses cork-app-state.

### toggle()

Opens the tray if it's closed, or closes it if it's open.

## Examples

**Import**

```js
import '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-nav-sub-popover';

// or the class only, without registering the element:
import CorkNavSubPopover from '@ucd-lib/cork-theme/elements/cork-nav-sub-popover/cork-nav-sub-popover.js';
```

**Use**

```html
<cork-nav-sub-popover button-label="In this section">
  <h2><a href="/services">Services</a></h2>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="/services/borrow">Borrowing</a></li>
    <li><button>Printing</button></li>
  </ul>
</cork-nav-sub-popover>
```

**Title as the button's text**

```html
<!-- the button says "Services", and the title isn't repeated in the tray -->
<cork-nav-sub-popover heading-label hide-heading>
  <h2>Services</h2>
  <ul>…</ul>
</cork-nav-sub-popover>
```

**Opening and closing from code**

```js
const popover = document.querySelector('cork-nav-sub-popover');
popover.show();
popover.hide();
popover.addEventListener('cork-popover-toggle', e => console.log(e.detail.open));
```
